job.job_description:
Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy production-grade AI agents using Large Language Models (LLMs).
Build autonomous agents capable of planning, reasoning, memory management, and tool usage.
Develop AI workflows using single-agent and multi-agent architectures.
Integrate LLM applications with enterprise APIs, databases, search systems, and business workflows.
Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for enterprise knowledge systems.
Work with open-source LLMs from the Hugging Face ecosystem, including model selection, fine-tuning, optimization, inference, and deployment for enterprise AI applications.
Optimize prompts, retrieval quality, latency, cost, and response accuracy.
Implement evaluation pipelines to measure agent quality, hallucination rate, task success, and latency.
Deploy AI services using containerized microservices and cloud infrastructure.
Build monitoring, logging, tracing, and guardrails for production AI systems.
Collaborate with full-stack, backend, and platform engineering teams to integrate AI capabilities.

Education & Experience

1. Experience: Skilled (3-5 years)

2. Qualification: B.Tech CSE, Artificial Intelligence, or a related discipline

*Is as plus: UG/PG course on or similar to: Generative AI

Technical Skills:

Strong proficiency in Python programming.
Hands-on experience developing LLM-powered applications using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or AutoGen.
Experience designing and building AI agents with planning, reasoning, memory, and tool-calling capabilities.
Experience implementing vector databases such as FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, or Milvus.
Practical experience with RAG pipelines and embedding-based retrieval systems.
Experience building data preprocessing pipelines for multiple formats including Excel, Word, PDFs, and images.
Strong understanding of Transformer architecture and the fundamentals of Large Language Models.
Experience working with open-source LLMs from Hugging Face, including model selection, inference, optimization, and deployment.
Experience fine-tuning and adapting LLMs using techniques such as LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT, or instruction tuning.
Experience integrating AI applications with REST APIs, enterprise systems, databases.
Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, and Redis.
Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills with the ability to collaborate effectively in cross-functional engineering teams.
